@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+const express = require("express");
+
+const {
+  getHospitals,
+  getHospitalDoctors,
+  createHospitalToken,
+  getHospitalQueueStatus,
+} = require("../controllers/hospitalController");
+
+const {
+  authMiddleware,
+  requireRole,
+} = require("../utils/auth");
+
+const router = express.Router();
+
+// ======================================================
+// GET ALL HOSPITALS
+// GET /api/v1/hospitals
+// ======================================================
+
+router.get("/", getHospitals);
+
+// ======================================================
+// GET DOCTORS FOR A HOSPITAL
+// GET /api/v1/hospitals/:id/doctors
+// ======================================================
+
+router.get(
+  "/:id/doctors",
+  getHospitalDoctors
+);
+
+// ======================================================
+// BOOK HOSPITAL APPOINTMENT
+// POST /api/v1/hospitals/tokens
+// ======================================================
+
+router.post(
+  "/tokens",
+  authMiddleware,
+  requireRole("ADMIN", "HOSPITAL", "USER"),
+  createHospitalToken
+);
+
+// ======================================================
+// PUBLIC LIVE QUEUE STATUS
+// GET /api/v1/hospitals/queue/status
+//
+// Citizen tracking does NOT require login.
+// ======================================================
+
+router.get(
+  "/queue/status",
+  getHospitalQueueStatus
+);
+
+// ======================================================
+// EXPORT
+// ======================================================
+
+module.exports = router;
